subject: OptiBank security intake: DPA & SCC routing and controller/processor clarity
messages:

Date: 2027-08-24T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + Security kickoff (OptiBank) - DPA & SCC clarification

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and routing options. Before we proceed to procurement, legal needs a short intake so we can route the DPA/SCC work correctly. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept the EEA controller/processor split we discussed (OptiBank as controller, Redwood as processor) or if you require any module choices that assume dual-controller behavior?
2) Please share your current SOC 2 status (type, date) and a one-page summary we can attach to the security packet.

Also, Procurement would like us to start the vendor security questionnaire — attaching the XLSX that they use. Can someone on your side pick this up?

Appreciate a short note back today — legal is trying to queue this for next-week review.

Thanks,
Daria Novak
Senior Legal Operations Manager
OptiBank

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-24T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + Security kickoff (OptiBank) - DPA & SCC clarification

Hi Daria — great to speak yesterday, and thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Controller/Processor: Redwood's default stance for SaaS inference is that the customer (OptiBank) is the controller and Redwood acts as processor. We do offer a controller-controller option in limited scenarios (typically where customers bring data into a Redwood-managed private instance), but for hosted/Dedicated deployments the DPA module we recommend is the Processor module. If you have specific language preferences from your legal team, send over redlines and we can map them against the DPA modules.

2) SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II, last audit completed 2026-11-15. I've attached a one-page SOC 2 summary and a DPA options overview for quick review.

3) Vendor security questionnaire: Rishi will own the questionnaire on our side. Rishi — can you take OptiBank's XLSX and return a completed first pass by EOD tomorrow?

Next steps (proposed):
- Rishi: complete vendor security questionnaire (deliverable: filled XLSX) — due 2027-08-25 EOD
- Priyom/Marissa: share DPA options PDF + call if legal wants module walkthrough — offer Thurs 08/26 10:00-11:00 CEST
- Daria/OptiBank legal: flag any mandatory SCC module preferences or retention clauses

Attachments: redwood_dpa_options_v2.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0198

Hi Daria — taking point on the questionnaire. I attached a first-pass export with comments for a couple of items that often need context (data residency, model caching).

Key notes in the XLSX:
- SOC 2 evidence referenced in answers (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf)
- We note that for inference logs we retain minimal request metadata by default; if OptiBank requires longer retention we can propose an addendum in the DPA.
- On SCC modules: we typically default to the Processor module (standard SCC clause). If your legal team requires the Controller module variant, we'll need a short architecture note (private VPC or customer-hosted model) to support that positioning.

I should have a cleaned-up version and a tracked-changes copy back to you by tomorrow morning (2027-08-26). Happy to jump on the call Priyom suggested if that helps.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Priyom — thanks, and Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround on the questionnaire. A couple of clarifying points from legal after reviewing your notes: 

- OptiBank's preference is to treat Redwood as processor for hosted services. We'll include language asking for confirmation that Redwood will not act as a co-controller for models trained on our data.
- On retention: we will propose a 90-day default retention for inference logs with an option to increase for specific regulated datasets. Please capture that in your DPA module examples.
- We'd like to schedule a 30-minute call with your compliance team to walk the DPA module language and the SCC module selection (someone from legal + procurement will be on the call). Are you available 2027-08-30 09:00-09:30 CEST?

If that slot works, please send calendar invite and any short pre-reads (1 pager) for the call. Procurement copied here will work the commercial packet in parallel.

Best,
